payload.title: Course-owned repair workshop review cut
payload.objective: Create a concise internal-review sequence that preserves the order and meaning of the fictional safety demonstration.
payload.audience: Course learners and a named instructional reviewer working entirely offline.
successCriteria: Introduce the fictional workshop purpose before the repair sequence begins.
Retain every safety qualification in its original chronological context.
Trace each selected frame range to a transcript, shot, or human-note locator.
Finish with a review invitation and never imply that publication occurred.
stopConditions: Stop when any source hash differs from the recorded fixity baseline.
Stop when an operation changes a qualification, chronology, or attribution.
Stop before any network, paid, export, upload, or publish action lacks authority.
Stop when the exact candidate version lacks a named human review decision.

limitations: The course-owned fixture uses playable synthetic video, tone audio, and fictional text rather than personal or third-party media.
A validated creative brief demonstrates contract structure and never grants external publication authority.
